text: **Clause 14 summary:** Brightside Physio needs the landlord's written consent to transfer the lease (assignment) or sublet any part of the premises. The landlord can't refuse unreasonably but may request the buyer's financials, a bank guarantee of three months' rent, and reimbursement of legal costs ($1,500 to $3,000). Brightside may stay liable for rent after an assignment, possibly for the rest of the term, because this is not a retail lease. Only a written release from the landlord ends that liability. Subletting is capped at 30% of floor area, with a shorter term and no structural changes. A change in company control also needs consent. The landlord has 28 days to respond. Before any sale, get legal advice on negotiating a release. Consent forms are available from Kingsley Property Group.
